title: Headers and fields docx 002
notes: real complex fields (fldChar begin / w:instrText / separate / cached run / end): PAGE + NUMPAGES fields with cached results in the first-page header; footer carries a DATE field (instr 'DATE \@ "yyyy-MM-dd"') with fixed cached value 2026-01-01. Body has 60 fixed-text paragraphs so LibreOffice paginates past two pages; header/footer strings are excluded from reference text because renderers re-evaluate fields per page. Fields live in header/footer parts, so w:instrText in word/document.xml stays 0.
